mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy easing supports risk asset performance.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.05 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% over the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending capacity and corporate earnings growth expectations, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises above 4.0% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1650 and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) below 620000 over the prior month indicates contraction in consumer housing demand, reducing sector revenue growth and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1650 and RSAFS < 620000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 over the prior month indicates manufacturing sector contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and profit margins, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during industrial downturns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior month signals strengthening consumer demand for housing, boosting construction sector activity and corporate revenue growth, which produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST increases by at least 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 285 over the prior month indicates accelerating inflation, triggering expectations of monetary tightening and reducing equity risk appetite, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises above 285.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% and decline in payrolls (PAYEMS) below 149000 over the prior month indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0 and PAYEMS < 149000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior week compresses short-term discount rates, generating immediate positive momentum in risk assets, which yields positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.05 percentage points over the prior week.
